pattern: ^\[WinGetMessageProcessor\] Processing Progress for app = {GUID}.*?- Operation Phase = Error
description: Marks a WinGet (new Store) app as failed when its operation progress reports phase Error (WinGetOperationInstallPhase: Downloading/Installing/Queued/Finished/Error). Before this pattern only the Installing phase was matched, so WinGet failures never surfaced as app errors (IME 1.97 audit 2026-08-17).
